entity.jujutsukaisen.mahoraga: Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga
item.jujutsukaisen.sukuna_finger.desc1: Special Grade Cursed Object — one of twenty
item.jujutsukaisen.sukuna_finger.desc2: A vessel who eats it gains Sukuna's power (Shrine). Deadly poison to anyone else.
item.jujutsukaisen.sukuna_finger.desc3: Feed it to a villager and the King of Curses incarnates.
item.jujutsukaisen.idle_death_gamble_imp: Technique Imprint: Private Pure Love Train
item.jujutsukaisen.technique_imprint.des: Use to engrave this technique into your brain (replaces your current one).
item.jujutsukaisen.sword_of_exterminatio: Imbued with positive energy: devastating to cursed spirits and the undead.
Once fused to Mahoraga's right arm.
item.jujutsukaisen.dharma_wheel.desc1: Bear it in your off hand: adapt to every phenomenon that hurts you.
item.jujutsukaisen.dharma_wheel.desc2: Each turn of the wheel builds resistance and heals part of that damage. Use: show adaptations.
Starts the taming ritual: Mahoraga attacks everyone involved, the summoner included.
Defeat it alone, by your own hand, to tame it. Tamed: summon for 400 cursed energy.
item.jujutsukaisen.prison_realm.desc: The cursed object that sealed Satoru Gojo. Open it, and the strongest walks free.
item.jujutsukaisen.fight_club_invitation: Use it and Kinji Hakari challenges you to a real fight.
item.jujutsukaisen.gojo_blindfold.desc: The Six Eyes see through it: night vision, immune to blindness and darkness.
domain.jujutsukaisen.clash_lost_self: Tch... my domain was pushed back.
chant.jujutsukaisen.hollow_purple: Nine Ropes. Polarized Light. Crow and Shomyo. Between Front and Back. Hollow Technique: Purple.

line.jujutsukaisen.gojo.released: Yo! Sorry to keep you waiting.

gamble.jujutsukaisen.jackpot.sub: 4:11 of unlimited cursed energy and automatic Reverse Cursed Technique
gamble.jujutsukaisen.rules_transmitted: Sure-hit: the rules have been transmitted into your brain
gamble.jujutsukaisen.rules: [Idle Death Gamble] The sure-hit is not damage but the rules. When Hakari uses a notice (Shutter Doors, Reserve Balls, Pseudo-Consecutive) a riichi starts; three matching numbers is a jackpot. On a jackpot, for 4 minutes 11 seconds his cursed energy is unlimited and his body performs Reverse Cursed Technique automatically. The only way to stop it is to defeat Hakari.
